hypotheses.reasoning: The third-party identity provider (idp.example token endpoint) started slowing down at 22:44, taking 4-7s per call, and then hung until auth-svc's 30s timeout. Because auth-svc /tokens calls hang, account-svc's 50-connection HTTP pool to auth-svc fills up and checkouts time out (#101, #108). account-svc then returns 503s, which edge-proxy passes back on POST /login.
The IdP may be fully down rather than just slow. But the logs show calls hanging until a timeout, not fast 5xx errors.

verdict.recommendedAction: Contact the IdP provider and check its status. Lower auth-svc's IdP timeout well below 30s and add a circuit breaker so slow IdP calls fail fast instead of draining account-svc's pool to auth-svc. If possible, keep existing sessions working while the IdP is degraded.
